--- a/slugs.py
+++ b/slugs.py
@@ -1,5 +1,10 @@
 import re
+import unicodedata
 
 
 def slugify(value):
-    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", value.lower()).strip("-")
+    normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", value)
+    ascii_text = "".join(
+        ch for ch in normalized if not unicodedata.combining(ch)
+    )
+    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", ascii_text.lower()).strip("-")

contract_tests: tests/test_slugify_unicode.py::test_precomposed_accented_phrase: assert slugify('Café déjà vu') == 'cafe-deja-vu' and isinstance(result, str).
patches.rationale: The current slugify lowercases and replaces non-[a-z0-9] runs with dashes, but accented characters like 'é' are not in [a-z0-9], so 'Café déjà vu' becomes '-caf-d-j-vu' (or similar) rather than 'cafe-deja-vu'. Fix: NFKD-normalize the input, drop combining marks, then apply the existing lowercase + non-alphanumeric-to-dash + strip logic. This preserves ASCII word separation and dash trimming, keeps the signature and str return type, and makes decomposed 'cafe'+U+0301 match precomposed 'café'. New regression tests in tests/test_slugify_unicode.py cover all acceptance contracts.
